product_brief: Edge platform providing global acceleration, DDoS protection, WAF, bot management, and built-in post-quantum hybrid key exchange for web properties.
pqc_support: Yes — X25519MLKEM768 hybrid key exchange enabled by default across ESA's global edge network for TLS 1.3 and QUIC (HTTP/3)
pqc_capability_description: ESA natively integrates X25519MLKEM768 hybrid key exchange (X25519 + ML-KEM-768) across its global edge network, enabled by default with zero configuration. Works with TLS 1.3 and QUIC (HTTP/3) when clients support it (Chrome/Edge 131+, Firefox 132+). Key exchange only; no PQC signatures stated.
crypto_primitives: X25519, ML-KEM-768, TLS 1.3 HKDF-based key schedule
primary_platforms: Alibaba Cloud global edge network; TLS 1.3 and QUIC (HTTP/3)
target_industries: Financial Services, Healthcare, Government and Defense, Intellectual Property, Automotive and IoT
testing_&_validation_methods: Verification of active PQC via browser DevTools Security tab or command `curl -vso /dev/null https://your-domain.com 2>&1 | grep -i mlkem`
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Zero-configuration default; no configuration changes, certificate replacements, or origin server modifications required. Additional handshake data ~2.3 KB, no additional round trips.

evidence.PQC Support: ESA natively integrates X25519MLKEM768 hybrid key exchange across its global edge network.
evidence.PQC Capability Description: Alibaba Cloud ESA (Edge Security Acceleration) has made it a zero-configuration default.
